title: Stocking
body:
"A festive stocking typically filled with surprises"

Stocking

The Stocking is a decorational item introduced in 1.45.0, or the Christmas Update. This item can also spawn in Gift Landings, the Christmas Update's version of Meteor Crashes.

Trivia

  • After clicking on the "Inscribe Name" button, the signature year will appear on the sock on one side, and the player's name on the other side.
  • This item is based off of stockings in real life, commonly used during Christmas.
